summary.text: Paul Seo is a Democratic candidate for California State Assembly District 66 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces fellow Democrat Sara Deen.
His campaign website describes him as a U.S. Army veteran, state prosecutor and the mayor of Rancho Palos Verdes.

paragraphs.text: Paul Seo was raised by Korean immigrant parents who owned a small business, according to his campaign website.
The site says he joined the Army before earning his law degree and has prosecuted violent crime and public corruption.
Seo's campaign site says he is running to crack down on corruption in Sacramento, lower the cost of living, keep communities safe and make government work for working families.
